export_evidence: ImportKey (https://importkey.com/countries/india/kisco-castings-india-limited): "Total Shipments 467 Records detected ... Latest Cargo 2026-02-28". Exact row quoted: "2026-02-26 | KISCO CASTINGS (INDIA) LIMITED | No Record | Square Alloy Steel ( 44 PCS )- HTPL ICD KILARAIPUR INQRH6, India | Haifa, Israel | 72283029 | 1064297". Other dated rows seen: 2026-02-28 Petrapole INPTPB -> BENAPOLE, Bangladesh, HS 84552200, BOL 1132198; 2026-02-07 ICD INSGF6 -> Jebel Ali, UAE, HS 72249040, BOL 9456212; 2026-01-31 ICD INQRH6 -> Haifa, Israel, HS 72283029, BOL 9270007. Source counter vs rows seen: page states 467 total shipments; 5 individual dated rows were actually visible on the free view (4 outbound export rows + 1 inbound import row of heavy melting scrap from Kuwait, HS 72044900, BOL 7208805). Top destination ports listed: Haifa 24, HTPL ICD Kilaraipur 17, Shuwaikh 10, Chawapayal ICD 10, Kilaraipur ICD 7.
domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record could be retrieved: web_search tool was unavailable (searx connection refused) for all queries, and registry pages returned HTTP 403 (zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com) and HTTP 404 (kiscocastings.com). No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split was seen. Domestic supply is therefore not confirmed and not denied — null, not invented.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with B/L numbers, HS codes and destinations (Israel, UAE, Bangladesh), Jan–Feb 2026, plus inbound scrap imports — i.e. the company is an active two-way metal trade participant, not merely a website claim. Declared HS 721420 (flat-rolled iron/non-alloy steel) does not match the observed export HS codes (72283029, 72249040 — alloy steel bars/forged rounds; 84552200 — rolling-mill machinery parts), so the HS code should be corrected to the actual observed codes per project rule 3; this is not a rejection ground. Note the ImportKey record set mixes exports and imports under one company profile, so 467 is a combined figure, not an export-only count. Domestic (India) supply evidence remains unverified — registries blocked, search down; recommend re-checking GST turnover and GeM/CPPP separately. No sanctions/court/ownership assessment performed (out of scope for this role).
